title: The other carbonyl position
hook: Predict the product, then compare the bonds.

knows: Structural formula bonds and common organic functional groups.
doesNotKnow: Hydroboration–oxidation of a terminal alkyne with a bulky borane gives an enol that tautomerizes to an aldehyde. The terminal carbon becomes the carbonyl carbon.

misconception: Reaction conditions do not affect the connectivity of the product.
objective: Predict the organic product of 1-butyne under the stated conditions and identify the changed connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structural diagrams, product and explanation: 1-butyne is treated with 1. bulky borane; 2. H₂O₂, OH⁻. Which major organic product forms after workup? Hydroboration–oxidation of a terminal alkyne with a bulky borane gives an enol that tautomerizes to an aldehyde. The terminal carbon becomes the carbonyl carbon.
The diagrams use condensed labels and depict connectivity rather than molecular geometry; highlighting identifies selected changed groups.
